To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the NLL corrections to the BJKL equation are finite and well behaved; (b) the initial results of the analysis of the corrections were wrong because of an error in the numerical integration; (c) the numerical integration can be done correctly and the results are finite; (d) the NLL analysis is consistent with the full NLL analysis of the BJKL kernel; (e) the NLL BFKK corrections are finite and well-behaved.
the initial analysis of NLL corrections to the BKFLequation was based on a wrong ansatz, and that a new ansatz is required.

we can reproduce the results obtained by the initial analyses at NLL accuracy and that the NLL corrections to the BJKL kernel are small and of the order of 5-15% for the physical range of parameters.
